title: Studying Metastatic Dormancy in 4T07-mCherry Breast Cancer Cells
author: Pereira, Cecconi, et al.
materials:
Timing: 30 min
7.Preparing the solutions and antibody mixes.a.Prepare a batch of 4% BSA in PBS and 1% BSA in PBS.Note: Aliquot these solutions into separate 2-mL tubes and store at −20°C until use.b.Prepare the permeabilization solution, consisting of 4% BSA and 0.01% Triton X-100 in PBS.Note: Aliquot this solution into 2-mL tubes and store at −20°C until use.c.Prepare the washing buffer, consisting of 0.05% Tween 20 in PBS.Note: Prepare 10 L of this buffer and store at 20°C–25°C.d.Prepare the primary antibody mix in PBS containing 1% BSA, as follows:i.Unlabeled goat anti-mCherry antibody, 1:400.ii.Unlabeled rabbit anti-Ki67 antibody, 1:100.iii.Labeled rat anti-CD45 in CoraLitePlus 647, 1:400.Note: Always prepare this solution on the day of staining.e.Prepare the secondary antibody mix in PBS containing 1% BSA, as follows:i.Donkey anti-goat antibody, 1:200.ii.Donkey anti-rabbit antibody, 1:200.f.Prepare the nucleus staining solution by diluting DAPI in water (1:5000, Thermo Fisher).

This section describes the staining protocol to label mCherry, Ki67, CD45 and the nucleus of the cells of the lung sections.7.Fixing and permeabilizing the lung sections.a.Place the slides on a slide-staining tray.b.Fix the slides in 4% formaldehyde in PBS for 10 minutes at 20°C–25°C.Note: The cells are already fixed from the inflation and incubation of the lungs with 4% formaldehyde. This step prevents the lung sections from detaching from the slides during the subsequent washing steps.c.Wash 3 times with PBS.Note: Perform each wash for 5 minutes at 20°C–25°C on a rocking platform with gentle sideways agitation. Use these settings for all subsequent washing steps in this section.d.Gently dry the region around the sections with a tissue.e.Encircle the dried region of the slide with a hydrophobic barrier pen (Vector Laboratories).Note: Make a single hydrophobic barrier on the slide, so that all 3 lung sections are within that area.f.Incubate the encircled region of the slides for 10 minutes at 20°C–25°C with 100 μL of the permeabilization solution.CRITICAL: This step is required for staining intracellular proteins, such as Ki67.g.Wash once with PBS containing 0.05% Tween 20.8.Primary and secondary antibody stainings.a.Incubate the slides 12-16 hours at 4°C with 100 μL of the primary antibody mix.CRITICAL: Incubate the slide containing healthy, cancer cells-free lung sections (from here on referred to as the autofluorescence slide) with the unlabeled goat anti-mCherry antibody only.CRITICAL: Perform the incubations in a humidified chamber to prevent the sections from drying.b.Wash 3 times with PBS containing 0.05% Tween 20.c.Incubate the slides for 1 hour at 20°C–25°C with 70 μL of the secondary antibody mix.Note: Incubate the autofluorescence slide with the same secondary antibody mix. Perform this incubation in a humidified chamber to prevent the sections from drying.d.Wash 3 times with PBS containing 0.05% Tween 20.e.Incubate the slides for 5 minutes at 20°C–25°C with 100 μL of the nucleus staining solution.Note: Incubate the autofluorescence slide with 100 μL of water only.f.Wash with PBS containing 0.05% Tween 20.g.Place 3 drops of ProLong Diamond Antifade Mountant onto a cover slip.h.Hold the slide with the lung sections at an angle of 45°.i.Place the end of the slide onto the coverslip, allowing the first drop on the coverslip to touch the slide.j.Slowly lower the slide onto the coverslip.k.Firmly press the lateral edges of the slide onto the coverslip.CRITICAL: Do not press onto the tissue.Note: Remove any bubbles that may have formed by applying gentle pressure with a P1000 plastic tip.l.Store the slides at 4°C until the acquisition of immunofluorescence.

steps.title: Harvest and prepare 4T07‑mCherry cells
steps.instruction: Collect confluent 4T07‑mCherry cells (60‑90% confluence) from a T75 flask, aspirate medium, rinse gently with 5 mL PBS (do not add directly onto cells), add 3 mL trypsin, swirl, incubate 5 min at 37 °C, collect cells with complete DMEM, centrifuge 350 g for 5 min at 4 °C and aspirate supernatant.

steps.title: Resuspend, count and adjust cell density
steps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet in 1 mL ice‑cold PBS, mix an aliquot 1:1 with 0.4 % trypan blue in PBS, count live cells (≈4 × 10⁶ live cells per T75 flask), then dilute with ice‑cold PBS to 2.0 × 10⁶ live cells / mL (injection mix). Prepare 20 % excess volume; keep cells on ice and proceed immediately to injection.

steps.title: Anesthetize mouse and give analgesia
steps.instruction: Transfer mouse to induction box with 3 % isoflurane and O₂ flow 0.8 L min⁻¹, confirm loss of pedal reflex, maintain all subsequent steps on a 37 °C warm pad, subcutaneously inject fentanyl 0.04 mg kg⁻¹ into the neck using a 30 G insulin syringe, place mouse supine with snout in the isoflurane/O₂ tube, and apply ophthalmic ointment to the eyes.

steps.title: Prepare surgical field and resect tumor
steps.instruction: Shave the lower right abdominal quadrant with hair clippers (no depilatory cream), disinfect with 70 % ethanol, reconfirm absence of pedal reflex, then perform tumor resection: cut skin clockwise from cranial to caudal end of the tumor, clamp and cut above the feeding vessel, remove tumor‑draining lymph node, excise tumor, staple cranial wound region and stitch caudal wound region.

steps.title: Inflate and fix lungs post‑mortem
steps.instruction: Fill a 5 mL syringe with 4 % formaldehyde in PBS, connect to an IV plastic cannula, insert cannula into the trachea, adjust tweezers to hold trachea against the cannula, inflate lungs with 2–3 mL 4 % formaldehyde, then transfer lungs to a 50 mL tube containing 4 % formaldehyde at 20–25 °C and incubate 15 min.

steps.title: Dehydrate lungs in sucrose series
steps.instruction: Transfer lungs to 50 mL tube with 15 % sucrose in PBS at 4 °C and incubate 12–16 h, then move to 30 % sucrose in PBS at 4 °C and incubate 2 days.

steps.title: Prepare staining reagents and antibody mixes
steps.instruction: Make 4 % BSA in PBS and 1 % BSA in PBS (aliquot 2 mL, store –20 °C); prepare permeabilization solution (4 % BSA + 0.01 % Triton X‑100 in PBS, aliquot 2 mL, store –20 °C); prepare washing buffer (0.05 % Tween 20 in PBS, 10 L, store 20–25 °C). On staining day, mix primary antibodies in PBS + 1 % BSA: goat anti‑mCherry 1:400, rabbit anti‑Ki67 1:100, rat anti‑CD45‑CoraLitePlus 647 1:400. Mix secondary antibodies in PBS + 1 % BSA: donkey anti‑goat 1:200, donkey anti‑rabbit 1:200. Dilute DAPI 1:5000 in water.

steps.title: Acquire fluorescence references in Vectra
steps.instruction: Open Vectra 3.0.7, select “Check Dashboard”, choose “Fluorescence References”, and acquire references using the provided slide.

steps.title: Create Vectra protocol and study folder
steps.instruction: From the Vectra dashboard, select “Edit Protocol” → “New…”, create a new study (folder), name the protocol, set Imaging Mode to Fluorescence, and save the protocol within the new study.

steps.title: Fix and permeabilize lung sections on slides
steps.instruction: Place slides on a staining tray, fix in 4 % formaldehyde in PBS for 10 min at 20–25 °C, wash 3 × 5 min with PBS on a rocking platform (20–25 °C), gently dry around sections, draw a single hydrophobic barrier around all three sections with a Vector Laboratories pen, incubate 10 min at 20–25 °C with 100 µL permeabilization solution, then wash once with PBS + 0.05 % Tween 20.

steps.title: Incubate primary antibodies
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL primary antibody mix to each encircled region and incubate 12–16 h at 4 °C in a humidified chamber (autofluorescence control slide receives only goat anti‑mCherry).

steps.title: Wash and apply secondary antibodies
steps.instruction: Wash slides 3 ×  with PBS + 0.05 % Tween 20, then incubate 1 h at 20–25 °C with 70 µL secondary antibody mix (autofluorescence slide receives same secondary mix) in a humidified chamber.

steps.title: Nuclear staining, mounting and storage
steps.instruction: Wash 3 ×  with PBS + 0.05 % Tween 20, incubate 5 min at 20–25 °C with 100 µL DAPI solution (autofluorescence slide receives 100 µL water), wash once with PBS + 0.05 % Tween 20, place three drops of ProLong Diamond Antifade Mountant on a cover slip, mount slides at a 45° angle, lower and press edges without contacting tissue, remove bubbles with a P1000 tip, and store slides at 4 °C until imaging.
